other_conditions: The deceased must have been domiciled in the state of Jharkhand.
The deceased must have been a Registered Worker with the Jharkhand Building and Other Construction Worker Welfare Board (JBOCWW Board).
The deceased must have been receiving a pension from the board.
The applicant must be a child of the deceased and orphaned after the death of the pensioner.
benefits_summary: Orphaned children under 18 receive the deceased worker’s family pension, equally divided among them.
